newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BILIC HAPPY TO SIGN FOR EVERTON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BILIC HAPPY TO SIGN FOR EVERTON.

text.p: Croatia's Slaven Bilic became one of English soccer's highest-paid defenders on Wednesday when he joined Everton from West Ham for 4.5 million pounds ($7.3 million).

Bilic, 28, has signed a lucrative five-year deal after Everton unearthed a clause in his contract which permitted him to talk to any club prepared to pay more than four million pounds ($6.5 million) for his signature.
Bilic cost West Ham 1.6 million pounds ($2.6 million) just 18 months ago, but now joins a club without a manager following the departure of Joe Royle in March.
"I knew about the club when I was playing in Croatia and they are a member of the 'Big Five' in England," said Bilic.
"They are ambitious and they want to win the title and that's what I want to do here.

"I refused to sign before because I didn't want to leave West Ham in the bad position they were in. I'm really glad that Everton waited for me and that West Ham stayed up. It's the perfect result for me."
